events.event: The DPR plenary led by Speaker Puan Maharani enacted the Asset Forfeiture Law (UU Perampasan Aset) after all factions agreed, ending a process that began in 2008.
events.key_numbers: Drafting since 2008 (18 years) · 361 of 573 members attended/signed in · Komisi III tingkat I approval 18 Nov, no factional notes · covers corruption, narcotics, terrorism financing, trafficking, IT-based fraud · conviction-based and non-conviction-based forfeiture · special agency formed by the President
events.why_it_matters: A law that lets the state seize assets from crime proceeds, even without a conviction, is finally in place after 18 years.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional top items 19 Nov; reported by Kompas.id, ANTARA, IDN Times

events.event: DPR left the illicit enrichment (unexplained wealth) provision out of the Asset Forfeiture Law, and ICW criticised the House for avoiding it.
events.key_numbers: Illicit enrichment not included in the enacted law (headline-level; details not opened)
events.why_it_matters: Officials whose wealth cannot be explained may still escape the new law, which is the main criticism from anti-corruption groups.
events.spreading_evidence: two CNN Indonesia items on 19 Nov

events.event: Polri set a new Perpol mechanism under which Listyo Sigit's ethics hearing can be chaired by a lower-ranking officer, and said the hearing will be held next week; two co-suspect generals were already dismissed (PTDH) by ethics panels.
events.key_numbers: Ahrie Sonta: KKEP hearing 10 Nov, PTDH · Eko Hadi Santoso: KKEP hearing 17 Nov, PTDH · Listyo hearing 'pekan depan' (date and chair not announced; 24 Nov mentioned by Bangkapos) · panel members may be one level higher, equal, or at most two levels below the accused (Perpol 4/2026 Pasal 42) · Slamet Uliandi not detained (health)
events.why_it_matters: A former police chief faces an ethics trial and critics ask whether a lower-ranking officer can fairly judge him.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional 19 Nov (2 items); Detik, Jawapos, Liputan6

events.event: Defense Minister Sjafrie visited DPR leaders and met Dasco, then denied discussing the vice-presidential slot, while support for Dasco as Gibran's replacement keeps growing.
events.key_numbers: MPR plenary to elect VP: Wed 9 Dec 2026 (moved from 2 Dec on 16 Nov) · 2 names from Prabowo, MPR has up to 60 days · MPR formed two 36-member teams (verification, ad hoc) · no candidate officially named
events.why_it_matters: Who becomes the next Vice President will be decided by the MPR in three weeks, and names are being floated now.
events.spreading_evidence: 4 CNN Indonesia nasional items on 19 Nov on the VP slot

events.event: DPR Deputy Speaker Dasco denied allegations that he is involved in online gambling and data dissemination.
events.key_numbers: Details not opened (ANTARA video headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Allegations hit the politician most often named as the next Vice President.

events.event: DKPP is merging four ethics cases against KPU members over the 'Pasal Gibran' issue into a single hearing.
events.key_numbers: 4 ethics cases merged into 1 hearing (headline only; hearing date not seen)
events.why_it_matters: Election officials face an ethics hearing over the rule that enabled Gibran's candidacy.

events.event: A petition at the Constitutional Court challenges the minimum age for presidential and vice-presidential candidates and proposes a minimum of 19 years.
events.key_numbers: Proposed minimum age: 19 (headline only; current limit and petitioner not seen)
events.why_it_matters: The age rule that let Gibran run is being tested again, now in the opposite direction.

events.event: PPP Secretary-General Taj Yasin said he has not received an official letter about his removal from the post.
events.key_numbers: Details not opened (headline only; who ordered removal not seen)
events.why_it_matters: A party shake-up inside PPP; relevant mainly to politics followers.

events.event: Komisi XI member Misbakhun said a Presidential Decree (Keppres) already converts LKPP into the Government Goods and Services Procurement Agency, and Komisi XI is preparing a public procurement bill.
events.key_numbers: Said at Baleg consultation 17 Nov 2026 · decree number and date not given · Komisi XI audience with LKPP 29 Oct · bill timeline not given · no monetary figures in the article
events.why_it_matters: Follow-up to Prabowo's Rp480T 'hangus' claim: the single procurement agency he asked for is taking shape, but the Keppres itself is not yet public.

events.event: President Prabowo witnessed signings of Indonesia-China deals worth about US$71.8 billion (over Rp1,300 trillion) in Shenzhen, mostly through Danantara.
events.key_numbers: US$71.8 billion (> Rp1,300 T) · smart city ~US$50 B (10 initial locations, Danantara-Shaanxi consortium) · Hisense ~US$10 B · infrastructure financing ~US$10 B (Danantara-SDIC) · coal-to-ethanol US$1.8 B (MoU, Pertamina) · construction of smart city 'early next year' (Rosan)
events.why_it_matters: A huge headline number; whether it is real investment or MoUs, and who pays, is what viewers will ask.

events.event: President Prabowo sat next to Russian President Putin at the APEC gala dinner, per ANTARA.
events.key_numbers: Gala dinner seating; exact date not stated in the headline (reported 19 Nov)
